note: Missions whose bot run does not pass on the sf bake yet (M05c1). check:missions prints each as KNOWN GAP and does not run it; DV_RUN_KNOWN_GAPS=1 runs it anyway, and a gap that passes is reported so that its row can be deleted. A row names why and what closes it. The missions themselves are playable and compile clean; the gap is the autoplayer, or the world under it, not the IR.

m.a1.02.reason: The 4th and King to 24th Street station trip is 3.4 km; the bot reaches about 1.2 km in the 240 s limit and then hits a curb at speed. The limit is the spec's (times the player's timer scale).
m.a1.02.closedBy: bot cornering and speed plan on long real-street legs (a follow-up to BD-M05c1-03)

m.a1.03.reason: The drift show is optional for the bot (the drift pattern builds no slip on the Bayview apron: off-road rolling drag keeps the car under 5 m/s), and the raid escape at heat 2 needs the bot to leave the Yard apron by a road, where it crawls and is busted.
m.a1.03.closedBy: bot driving off-road and out of the Yard (the same follow-up)

m.a1.06.reason: The bot drives the van off the warehouse street and along the 1.5 km route to the hill, but the hill streets are steep dead ends: it wrecks the van (the 40 percent health rule) at about tick 18,000, three hundred seconds in.
m.a1.06.closedBy: bot braking on steep grades and dead-end stubs (the same follow-up), or a hill zone on a through street
